name: tabjam
description: Synchronized multi-device tab practice for bands

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tabjam/shared && npm run build -w @tabjam/backend && npm run build -w @tabjam/frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @tabjam/backend" "npm run dev -w @tabjam/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tabjam/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tabjam/backend && npm run typecheck -w @tabjam/frontend
